# Pickings back to draft

## SUMMARY
Reopen canceled transfers

## DESCRIPTION
This module allows to bring canceled transfers back to draft

## USAGE
Just open a canceled transfer and click on the 'back to draft' button

functions.name: Reopen canceled transfers
functions.description: Allows users to reset canceled inventory transfers back to the draft state by clicking a button on the canceled picking.
functions.evidence: This module allows to bring canceled transfers back to draft
